direction.premise: A personal scouting notebook for two friends who want to understand years of shared matches, with measured evidence rather than competitive ranking between them.
direction.composition: Two independent ten-slot lineup sheets share the desktop spread and stack on phones; player labels combine name and career count. The chapter rail is secondary to the lineups.
direction.shapeLanguage: Ruled lineups with compact numbered portrait slots, rectangular color strips and match count bars drawn directly beneath the names.
direction.surfaceAndMaterial: Warm uncoated paper, saturated ink straps in pine and brick, and locally cached portrait crops.
direction.paletteLogic: Cream supports extended reading, dark green groups navigation, lime marks selected context, muted rust marks a small sample rather than a losing player.
direction.typography: Large tight headings introduce chapters, compact sans-serif tables use tabular numeric context, and small uppercase source labels separate claims from qualifications.
direction.signature: Tap a portrait row to open the correct player and hero dossier directly; inspect the breakdown then return to the same row.
direction.distinction: Unlike the Rivals DNA questionnaire, this opens directly on two independent ranked-by-frequency lineup sheets. Folkarium has an editor canvas and playback transport; neither dominates this data viewer.

architecture.primaryVerb: Inspect numbered slots directly to open either player’s hero dossier, then return to the same slot or follow it into the seasonal chart.
architecture.physicalFeedback: A press shifts that slot by one pixel and lights its left edge; the dossier overlays the current scroll position and returns focus to the original slot on close.
architecture.spatialRationale: Two separate lineup sheets dominate the wide screen. Phones stack the same two lists, with a direct jump to Yasia’s lineup. Each slot is its own entry point to the dossier overlay.

comparisons.spatialDifference: The score editor reserves a track rail and instrument inspector around a canvas; here the two player lineups themselves are the main reading surfaces.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Opening a slot retrieves one player’s evidence without writing pitches or maintaining playback.

comparisons.spatialDifference: The language trainer stages one exercise under a timer; both complete player lineups remain directly scannable on this home screen.
comparisons.interactionDifference: A hero opens an optional dossier and returns to its exact source slot; exercise answers do not drive sequential progression.

comparisons.spatialDifference: The hero matching app brings forward one context question at a time; this app begins with both full rosters, labelled match and win columns, and no questionnaire.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Select a hero on the roster to inspect recorded games in an overlay; nothing must be answered to unlock it.

production.renderer: DOM and CSS retain selectable long-form analysis, accessible tables and responsive controls; inline SVG renders numeric seasonal plots without a raster chart dependency.
production.focalAsset: The focal asset is the actual evidence document. An original SVG R-and-slash notebook mark is authored locally for installation; external portraits are optional source-linked identifiers.

motion.character: Precise and immediate context changes keep repeated analytical filtering comfortable and avoid presenting animation as statistical significance.
motion.action: Tap Loki in the JustSadSock lineup to open his career dossier.
motion.anticipation: The row compresses inward by one pixel and gains a colored spine on press.
motion.response: Native dialog opens immediately over the lineup with Loki selected and his career evidence in view.
motion.followThrough: Closing the dialog restores focus to the tapped slot without losing the scroll position.
motion.interruption: Rapid chapter or account changes overwrite the current render immediately rather than queuing transitions.
motion.reducedMotion: Reduced-motion disables smooth scrolling and transitions; the same selection, account state and evidence remain visible.

evidence.expectedChange: Loki career dialog opens and displays his current total matches, role mechanics and incoming damage.
